name: Two-stroke kart, 100 cc rotary disc
notes: A 100 cc racing kart engine: 50.6 x 49.6 mm (99.7 cc), a rotary disc opening 145 degrees before top dead centre for 200, exhaust 196, transfers 132, an expansion chamber tuned near 14,500 rpm, a straight-through silencer. Redline 17,500. Published figures for the class: some 20 kW near 17,000 rpm. Ports and pipe are judgement for the class.

expect.note: the custom geometry's four-stroke derivation (core/layout.fm), which the two-stroke does not use: it fires once a turn a cylinder, evenly
